label: modern_population_sensitivity
label_text: Policy experiment on the modern population: not a replay or a costing of Budget 2012.

diagnosis.evidence: data/uk/events/inventory.jsonl expressibility note for budget_2012__income_tax_reduce_additional_rate_to_45p_in_2013_14 ('OBR costing is dominated by taxable-income response')
diagnosis.summary: The OBR's costing of the cut to 45p (-£110m in 2016-17) is net of a taxable-income response that offsets almost all of the static cost; a static run has no such response. Restoring 50% on income above £125,140 costs £6.3bn to £6.9bn statically on the modern population, which also has a lower threshold than the £150,000 of 2013 (dividends left out of the construction).

rows.title: Income tax: reduce additional rate to 45p in 2013-14
